summary.text: Ron Sorvaag is a Republican state senator from North Dakota who has represented District 45 since 2010 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists him as a partner in First Choice Apparel and Embroidery.

paragraphs.text: Sorvaag earned a B.A. in sociology from Concordia College in 1976, and his professional experience includes owning a small business.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as partner at First Choice Apparel and Embroidery.
He assumed office in the North Dakota State Senate in 2010, succeeding Tom Fiebiger.
Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Appropriations Education and Environment Division for 2023-2024 and as a member of the Senate Appropriations Committee in earlier sessions.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
